verdict.rationale: Zero documents an official MCP server (ZeroMCP) with tool endpoints for email management, which developers/agents can build against, but there is no evidence of a traditional SDK (client libraries in Python/JS/TS, API reference, package registry entry) — only generic 'developer-friendly' marketing claims and the MCP protocol docs. missing for 10: dedicated SDK packages/libraries, API reference docs beyond MCP tool list, independent developer corroboration of building against it.
